pages.title: Destinations
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Sky Villages** sit 150 to 250 blocks up in the Overworld.
- **Sky structures**: about one every 600 blocks; bring a ship that can land.
- **The Aether**: a glowstone portal frame lit with water.
- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Space**: the Moon, Mars, Mercury and Venus, by Dimensional Drive or rocket.
Vehicles need somewhere to go. This is a map of what the pack puts in the sky and on far worlds, where it lives, and what you can expect there.

pages.title: Sky Villages
pages.text: Create: Sky Village places villages high up in the Overworld, between about **150 and 250 blocks**. There are two kinds: the Sky Village and the Highwind Village. Expect villagers and Create loot.

pages.title: Aeronautics builds
pages.text: Creat Aeronautics Structures adds airships, airballoons, crashed planes, boats, an engineering house with an Engineer villager, and pillager versions.

pages.title: Discovery
pages.text:
Aeronautics Discovery adds events: planes and balloons fly over the Overworld at height, and balloons appear in villages. It also adds:

- Pillager Aviators
- Soaring Traders
- maps to temples, igloos, ancient cities and mineshafts

pages.title: Pin Wand
pages.text: From Aeronautics Discovery. Check its tooltip in game for how to use it.

pages.title: Soaring Trader
pages.text: A trader added by Aeronautics Discovery, with the Pillager Aviator as its hostile counterpart.

pages.title: Floating islands
pages.text: Moog's Soaring Structures scatters vanilla-style floating islands across the sky: houses, towers, ruins, trees, volcanoes, an arena and a floating Nether portal. Expect loot and mobs.

pages.title: Island loot
pages.text: Floating islands from Moog's Soaring Structures hold chests and mobs. Bring a ship that can land.

pages.title: How often
pages.text: You cover ground faster in the air, so the sky is sparser than the ground. Expect **about 3 sky structures per km²**, the rate vanilla places structures on the surface: one every **600 blocks** or so.

pages.title: Common and rare
pages.text:
Most sky structures are equally common, so a mod with many kinds, like Moog's islands, shows up more. Prizes stay rarer: the island arena, volcano and towers, the big Sky Village, the steampunk airship and the heavenly fortresses.\
\
Some islands only float over their own biome.

pages.title: The Aether
pages.text: The [#](2E5AAC)[Aether](entry://exploration/aether)[#]() is a separate dimension of floating islands. Its portal is built from a **glowstone frame lit with water**. Sky whales drift over the ocean in the Overworld; see [#](2E5AAC)[Weather and Danger](entry://flight/weather_and_danger)[#]().

pages.title: Ambrosium Shard
pages.text: A basic Aether resource. See [#](2E5AAC)[Dimensions](entry://exploration/dimensions)[#]() for the Aether and others.

pages.title: Beyond the sky
pages.text: For the highest destinations, fly an Aeronautics ship upward with a [#](2E5AAC)[Dimensional Drive](entry://space/aeronautics_bridge)[#](), or build a rocket. Northstar has the Moon, Mars, Mercury and Venus. See [#](2E5AAC)[Reaching Space](entry://space/reaching_space)[#]() and [#](2E5AAC)[Planets](entry://space/planets)[#]().
